task_interfaces.role: unfamiliar third-party Go syntax structure only
task_interfaces.permitted_input: immutable Go files and explicitly authorized source query
task_interfaces.permitted_native_action: controlled copy-only source transformation or source-analysis call, frozen separately before testing
task_interfaces.required_observable_consequence: source-indexed native task output produced by an unchanged, independently verifiable executable
task_interfaces.forbidden: invented labels, evaluator-provided symbol identity, copied solution, runtime source writes

task_interfaces.role: independently maintained gridworld executable source only
task_interfaces.permitted_input: only cell-local pretransition observation plus immediate-neighbor messages
task_interfaces.permitted_native_action: bounded environment-step action with authenticated environment process result
task_interfaces.required_observable_consequence: source-produced native step observation scoped to the surviving local cell, no target labels
task_interfaces.forbidden: global state, evaluator hidden maps, caller-supplied next bit, postlesion damaged-cell label

complete_resource_contract.measurement_order: paired randomized or ABBA repetitions preregistered independently
include: all persistent parameter and transient state
metrics: peak aggregate simultaneous process-tree RSS bytes
executable source and training receipt hashes
complete_resource_contract.stat_only_resource_smoke: Lower bounds only; sampled /proc group can miss short peaks, wait4 maxrss is peak single-process lineage statistic not aggregate.
complete_resource_contract.requirements: Independent hard nonregression, zero hard false positives and better unseen-task transfer versus strongest fully trained control before protected evaluation.

stop_rules: External repository authorship does not make task labels/splits independently held or unseen.
Never interpret a single controlled native source edit or synthetic gridworld as transferable cognition.
An executable from an external source must be authentically bound and must not create a new hidden observation oracle.
A meter whose group children escape or whose peak RSS is sampled/incomplete cannot certify all-in resource equivalence.
Do not dispatch scientific original, use paid API, alter controller, accepted refs, science ledger, or CKB-plane dependencies.
next_required_artifact: Independent FORGE-owned, source-history-verified task selector and source-bound environment interface, with immutable evaluation criteria and a process-tree validated peak memory meter.
